critical_facts: Sprint 01 completed successfully: all 11 missions done, 4/4 success criteria met.
Presidio recall achieved 0.9829 minimum (exceeding 0.95 target) across all priority entities.
All 5 priority formats (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, CSV, XLSX) successfully ingested end-to-end.
Qdrant performance optimized: 9.6ms max latency (under 10ms target) with adaptive hnsw_ef tiers.
Sprint 02 research (R2.1) completed: comprehensive quality assessment heuristics framework documented.
Vector storage operational: Qdrant with on-disk storage, scalar quantization, 12,800 chunks indexed.
Document & project read APIs are still missing; Document Library UI/CLI list flows remain blocked until B7.1 ships.
scripts/ingest_cli.py currently returns 401 because it never requests JWT tokens; B7.3 owns the fix so ingestion workflows can pass tests/integration/test_ingestion_flow.py.

Integration testing guardrails (cmos/docs/integration-testing-guide.md + structured prompting refs) are absent, keeping node cmos/context/integration_test_runner.js red; schedule B7.2 to restore telemetry gating.

system_components.ingestion: Upload endpoints, format routing (PDF/DOCX/PPTX/CSV/XLSX), redaction, chunking (500-1000 tokens with overlap), and processing state tracking.
system_components.redaction: Presidio-based pipeline with custom recognizers (PARTICIPANT_ID, PROJECT_ID), pseudonymization operators, recall 0.9829+ on priority entities.
system_components.vector_store: Qdrant collection with on-disk storage, scalar quantization (int8), HNSW indexing (m=16), adaptive hnsw_ef tiers, 12,800 chunks indexed, <10ms query latency.
system_components.evaluation: Synthetic corpus generation + presidio-research metrics, sprint efficacy script (B1.6).
system_components.rag_pipeline: Planned for Sprint 02: query embedding, vector search, GPT-4o-mini generation, context compression, semantic caching, tiered routing.

dependencies: tiktoken (for token counting in chunking and compression)

decisions_made.decision: Adopt FastAPI + PostgreSQL + Alembic for core service bootstrapping.
Leverage Fake PII generation and presidio-research evaluator for regression testing.
Use GPT-4o-mini as default LLM for RAG queries (per TR-03 research).
Implement rule-based quality assessment heuristics (not ML-based) per R2.1 research.
Adaptive Qdrant hnsw_ef tiers (96/108/120) based on top_k for latency optimization.
Three-pillar quality assessment framework: Linguistic Uncertainty, Answer Integrity, Source Provenance.
Onboarding workflow operates in trusted single-user mode; authentication deferred indefinitely (no device flow or CLI mandate).

Cloudflare vanity (namozine.com / api.namozine.com) now fronts the Railway UI/API with Full (Strict) TLS; env templates pin NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=https://api.namozine.com/api/v1 and CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS_PROD includes https://namozine.com + https://www.namozine.com.

Sprint 09 planned with 6 missions: hybrid search backend, faceted filters backend, search page UX fixes, search history, saved searches, and retrospective. Roadmap Week 15 alignment. (from PS-2025-11-15-001)
